claims: Jacob "Jake" Wilkins is the son of NBA Hall of Famer Dominique Wilkins.
Jacob "Jake" Wilkins is a 6'9" freshman forward for the Georgia Bulldogs basketball team as of the 2025-26 season.
Jacob "Jake" Wilkins played at Grayson High School in Lilburn, Georgia.
Jacob "Jake" Wilkins was ranked as the No. 10 small forward in the Class of 2025.
Jacob "Jake" Wilkins committed to playing for the University of Georgia Bulldogs.
Jacob "Jake" Wilkins wears number 21 for Georgia.
Number 21 is the only number retired by the school for Dominique Wilkins.
Jacob "Jake" Wilkins wears number 21 with special permission.
Jacob "Jake" Wilkins is often referred to as a "Baby Highlight" in reference to his father's "Human Highlight Film" nickname
